description: Declarative source of truth for MCP servers installed by setup.sh --mcp / setup.ps1 -Mcp. Edit this file to add or remove servers; the setup scripts read it at install time.

playwright.purpose: Browser automation for E2E render-checks, scraping, and visual verification. Use whenever a HTTP 200 is not enough proof that a page actually rendered.

notes: Plugin-managed MCPs (Notion, Slack, Gmail, Figma, Google Drive, ms365, GitHub Copilot, Remotion) are activated by enabling their plugin in settings.json — do NOT duplicate them here.

User-scope (`-s user`) installs are available across every project. Project-scope (`-s project`) writes to the repo's .mcp.json and ships to collaborators; only use that when the MCP is project-specific.
